discovery_notes: WDW 2025 open-edition pass; 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet (no page reads). Mostly WDWNT and Disney Pins Blog. 2025 dated series released Nov 2024 but included as 2025 merchandise. Several pins sold at both WDW and Disneyland. Festival OE pins largely not found (festivals skew LE/LR). Price conflicts kept (Princess 17.99 vs 14.99; Jack 14.99 vs Zero 12.99). Some entries lack an explicit OE statement and are logged in not_found. Kilimanjaro safari OE pins found but dated 2026, excluded. | Key fix 2026-10-16: 82 single-pin set keys renamed from <pin_key> to .../oe-single/<slug> (set key must differ from pin key).
